scope.summary: Implement StudioVariableCollection (hsk.studio.variable_collection@1) grouping variables and defining the collection's modes (e.g. light/dark, compact/comfortable); every variable stores one value per mode. Studio MUST NOT impose a provider-style plan-gated mode-count cap; mode count is bounded only by document and performance limits documented in 14.23.
acceptance_criteria: collection groups variables with one value per mode; no plan-gated cap
expected_tests: test: collection defines modes + one value per variable per mode; no plan-gated mode-count cap enforced

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No collection/mode grouping; mode-aware tokens impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
